name: Founding of Rio de Janeiro
description: The city of Rio de Janeiro was founded by the Portuguese.

name: Expansion of the Sugar Industry
description: The sugar industry in Rio de Janeiro expanded dramatically and the city became the largest exporter of sugar in the world.

name: Gold Discovery
description: Discovery of gold in the region led to Rio's growth as a port city.

name: Transfer of the Portuguese Court to Brazil
description: The Portuguese Court moved to Rio de Janeiro to avoid Napoleon's invasion of Portugal.

name: Independence of Brazil
description: Brazil gained independence from Portugal. Rio de Janeiro remained the capital.

name: Abolition of Slavery
description: Slavery was abolished in Brazil, impacting the economy and society of Rio de Janeiro.

name: Federal District
description: Rio de Janeiro became the Federal District, the capital of Brazil.

name: Revolt of the Navy
description: Revolt of the navy happened in Rio de Janeiro and became known as the Revolta da Armada.

name: Start of the Coffee Industry
description: The coffee industry started to grow, making Rio de Janeiro one of Brazil's main export ports for coffee.

name: Transfer of the Capital to Brasília
description: The capital of Brazil was moved from Rio de Janeiro to Brasília.

name: Military Rule
description: Brazil underwent a military dictatorship, which affected Rio de Janeiro significantly.

name: Democratic Return
description: Brazil returned to democracy, changing the political climate in Rio de Janeiro.

name: Rio Conference
description: The city hosted the United Nations Conference on Environment and Development, also known as the Rio Summit or Earth Summit.

name: Rio de Janeiro Massacre
description: The Candelária Church massacre, where eight young people were killed, shocked the city and the world.

name: 2007 Pan American Games
description: The city hosted the 2007 Pan American Games, a major international sports event.

name: Rio World Cup
description: Brazil hosted the FIFA World Cup, with Rio de Janeiro serving as a main venue.

name: Zika Virus Outbreak
description: The Zika virus outbreak began in Rio de Janeiro and spread throughout Brazil and other countries.

name: Rio Olympics
description: The city hosted the Summer Olympic Games.

name: Political Crisis
description: A political crisis enveloped Brazil, leading to the impeachment of President Dilma Rousseff.

name: Marielle Franco Assassination
description: Marielle Franco, a city councilor of Rio de Janeiro, was assassinated.

name: COVID-19 Pandemic
description: The COVID-19 pandemic hit Brazil, severely affecting Rio de Janeiro.
